rules.statement: When a gift is described as 'Stridanum' but the evidence shows it was intended to be an absolute gift to the bridegroom, the intention of the donor should prevail.
rules.supporting_quote: "However in assessing the evidence of intention the fact that the donation has been designated "Kaikuli" or "Stridanum" cannot be ignored, because these are terms widely in use and the majority of Muslims, I take it, know what they connote. But I am unable to agree with the learned District Judge when he stated 'It will be a contradiction in terms to describe a gift given to a man as "Stridanum".'"
